response.reason: A bitonic sort network is not stable: when scores tie, the compare-and-swap (cond = (left > right) != flip) performs no swap for equal values at that step, but earlier stages have already permuted the ids, so the surviving id for tied scores is arbitrary and not guaranteed to be the lower index, violating the stated tie-break contract.
